name: Template-NEXT
summary: Next.js starter with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Compiler, Turbopack, next-themes and a shadcn/ui preset.
description: A clean Next.js starter created with npx @edward-hyde/template-next. TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Compiler, Turbopack and next-themes are wired up along with the shadcn/ui preset b1YmqvjRA; formatting and linting come preconfigured, and the create command lets you pick the project name, package manager, shadcn/ui components and options.
contains: TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Compiler, Turbopack
formatting and linting already wired up
create command: project name, package manager, shadcn/ui components, options
